name: refactor-companion
description: Portable refactor-companion skill conformance: preserve developer intent, ask at design conflicts, and simplify residue before handoff

scenarios.name: conflicting design: ask before editing
scenarios.prompt: I am vibe-coding a refactor branch. The current code has two entry points and a generic callback wrapper. I want one direct path, but I have not decided whether the public contract keeps the old entry point. Read `.claude/skills/refactor-companion/SKILL.md` first. Inspect the repository for facts, then ask me one focused question before editing because the contract choice changes the design.

judge: The agent treated the developer's design choice as unresolved, asked one focused question, and did not edit or silently choose a compatibility policy.
